question: For each rating category of the first movie rented by customers—where the first movie is identified based on the earliest payment date per customer—please provide the average total amount spent per customer and the average number of subsequent rentals (calculated as the total number of rentals minus one) for customers whose first rented movie falls into that rating category.

arguments.sql:
WITH first_rental AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id, p.rental_id,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY p.customer_id ORDER BY p.payment_date, p.payment_id) AS rn
  FROM payment p
),
first_movie AS (
  SELECT fr.customer_id, f.rating
  FROM first_rental fr
  JOIN rental r ON r.rental_id = fr.rental_id
  JOIN inventory i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  WHERE fr.rn = 1
),
cust_stats AS (
  SELECT p.customer_id,
         SUM(p.amount) AS total_amount,
         COUNT(DISTINCT p.rental_id) AS total_rentals
  FROM payment p
  GROUP BY p.customer_id
)
SELECT fm.rating,
       AVG(cs.total_amount) AS avg_total_amount,
       AVG(cs.total_rentals - 1) AS avg_subsequent_rentals
FROM first_movie fm
JOIN cust_stats cs ON cs.customer_id = fm.customer_id
GROUP BY fm.rating
ORDER BY fm.rating;
